overview: David Ondrej discusses refusal-suppressed open models, local inference hardware and connecting coding harnesses to self-hosted inference.
whyItMatters: The refusal mechanism is plausible, but lower refusal frequency does not establish accurate answers, safe tools or verified software outcomes.
ghostMeshTakeaway: Pilot a base and refusal-suppressed model on identical authorized tasks with bounded tools and independent scoring of valid findings.
